thread:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy started: rollout/2026-03-15-12h -> service/ranking (canary=10%). Observability checkers reporting elevated error rate for canary pods, creating thread.
Carla R: seeing 5xx spike on canary, looks like request-path /v1/score is affected. Not all traces are coming through.
Mike H: I can't find the canary dashboard for this rollout in the usual place, dashboards/rollouts/ranking-canary seems empty? Did the dashboard id change in this deploy?
Jen (SRE): Confirmed alerts are noisy. Alert:ranking.canary.500-rate firing but panels show gaps. I suspect a metrics-tag rename in the build.
Dave L: if metric names changed, SLO burn will be incorrect. Are we seeing real user 5xx or missing signal? Customer telemetry shows a few errors in prod.
Carla R: reproducing locally with canary config, getting NPE in scorer when payload has missing feature blob. This code path was touched in the PR.
Mike H: tagging @jen for metrics -> we need to know whether alerts reflect true errors. Can we get raw logs?
Jen (SRE): pulling logs from canary pods now. Note: logging pipeline to observability was briefly rate-limited during rollout window, might explain gaps.
Incident Bot: New incident created INC-2026-093: "Ranking canary error spike + missing observability panels" (sev:high). Pager duty notified: Oncall Rotation.
Oncall Rotation: I'm on pager, jumping in. Carla, do we have a quick mitigation?
Carla R: I can flip the feature flag for the new scorer to off. Command: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_API' https://flags.redwood/api/v1/toggle -d '{"flag":"new-scorer","state":"off"}'``` Doing dry-run, will execute in 2 mins unless someone objects.
Mike H: do it. We should also pause the rollout in k8s so more canaries don't get new pods. `kubectl rollout pause deploy/ranking`
Carla R: executing FF toggle now. Response: {"flag":"new-scorer","state":"off","updated":true} :white_check_mark:
Dave L: Pause applied: `kubectl rollout pause deploy/ranking` - confirmed no new canary pods scheduled.
Jen (SRE): Incident note: SLO query for ranking.latency uses metric name `ranking_request_latency_ms` which the new build renamed to `req_latency_ms`. I'll open a quick mapping rule to surface both until we fix code. Patching alert rule to look at either.
Mike H: good catch. Can we add a temporary recording rule: `or(ranking_request_latency_ms, req_latency_ms)`?
Jen (SRE): yep, added recording rule and new alert group. Alerts noise down by ~80% in the past 3 minutes.
Incident Bot: Alert suppression engaged for alert:ranking.canary.500-rate to avoid pager storms during triage.
Oncall Rotation: Customers: we have 12 erroring requests in last 10m tied to the canary IP range, low impact but visible. Communicating to support.
Carla R: root cause looks like nil-check regression in scorer when feature blob absent. PR 4825 had an unguarded field. We'll revert the change in next patch but FF-off buys time.
Dave L: starting a rollback PR to revert the scorer change and running quick unit tests. ETA ~25m.
Mike H: docs: add runbook note that deploys that rename metrics must include dashboard migration step. Also remind owners to keep metric aliases.
Jen (SRE): Handoff: I'll own until rollback completes and dashboards are validated. Oncall Rotation, pass to next oncall in 30m unless you want it.
Oncall Rotation: passing to Dave L in 30m. Posting incident update to #incidents and to INC-2026-093.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-093 updated: mitigation in place (feature flag off, rollout paused, temporary recording rules). Next steps: revert scorer change, add metrics alias, and add dashboard smoke test in CI.
Carla R: quick postmortem note: tagging responsible PR and adding test coverage for missing feature blobs.
Mike H: thanks everyone. We'll keep incident open until rollback validated and no regressed SLOs for 60m.
Jen (SRE): final note: plan to add an alert lint rule in CI that fails if a deploy renames metrics referenced by dashboards.
Dave L: rollback merged and deployed to canary, re-enabling rollout in 5m to sanity check.
Oncall Rotation: monitoring - canary 5xx back to baseline, dashboards showing full traces again. Closing on-call handoff in 20m. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-093 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Carla R: will follow up with a short incident write-up and remediation tasks in the ops board.
Mike H: appreciate the fast moves.
Jen (SRE): tl;dr: feature toggle + pause rollout = allowed safe rollback; root cause = unguarded field + metric rename. Action items assigned.
